sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Azure King's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases ATK and MATK 100%, increases status ailment resistance by 50, increases DEF and MDEF for all allies by 100%, increases status ailment resistance for all allies by 50. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
Wind and Light Defense from Unison Damage +700
